abstract: Twenty-five cases of pure ovarian dysgerminoma treated at UCLA Medical Center between 1958 and 1992 were reviewed retrospectively. Patterns of recurrence and overall survival were analyzed with regard to primary surgery (conservative versus nonconservative), use of adjuvant therapy, and stage of disease. Fourteen patients (56%) underwent conservative surgical therapy defined as preservation of the contralateral ovary, 10 patients (40%) had nonconservative primary surgery, and one patient (4%) had chemotherapy as primary treatment. Three patients (12%) received adjuvant chemotherapy and nine patients (36%) received postoperative radiation therapy. Fifteen patients (60%) had stage I disease, four (16%) stage II, and three each (12%) had stage III and IV disease. Nine patients (36%) experienced recurrence of disease. Seven of these nine patients (78%) had stage I disease and all seven had undergone conservative primary surgery with preservation of the contralateral ovary. Six of the seven had received no adjuvant therapy. Only one of these seven patients experienced recurrence in the preserved ovary. She was found to have a dysgenetic ovary and an XY karyotype. Three patients with recurrent disease had received radiation therapy after primary surgery. Twenty patients (80%) were alive without disease at follow-up, two patients (8%) were alive with disease, and three (12%) had died of disease. There was no statistically significant difference in recurrence rates between those patients treated with conservative surgery and those treated with nonconservative surgery, although the total number of patients with recurrences was greater in the former group. Our data suggest that a conservative surgical approach is the preferred treatment in patients with pure dysgerminoma of the ovary who desire future fertility. Lack of adjuvant chemotherapy or radiation therapy, rather than type of initial surgery, may be associated with a higher risk of recurrence.
abstract_ja: 1958年から1992年にかけてUCLA医療センターで治療された純粋卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ25例を後方視的に検討した。再発のパターンと全生存期間を、初回手術の種類（保存的か非保存的か）、補助療法の使用、病期により解析した。14例（56%）は対側卵巣を温存する保存的手術を受け、10例（40%）は非保存的初回手術を受け、1例（4%）は初回治療として化学療法を受けた。3例（12%）が補助化学療法を、9例（36%）が術後放射線療法を受けた。病期Iは15例（60%）、病期IIは4例（16%）、病期IIIとIVはそれぞれ3例（12%）であった。9例（36%）が再発を経験した。再発した9例のうち7例（78%）は病期Iで、この7例はすべて対側卵巣を温存する保存的初回手術を受けていた。このうち6例は補助療法を受けていなかった。温存卵巣で再発したのは1例のみで、この患者は異形成卵巣とXY核型を有していた。再発した患者のうち3例は初回手術後に放射線療法を受けていた。20例（80%）がフォローアップ時に無病生存し、2例（8%）が病勢を伴って生存し、3例（12%）が原病で死亡した。保存的手術群と非保存的手術群の間で再発率に統計学的有意差はなかったが、再発患者の総数は前者で多かった。当施設のデータは、妊孕性を希望する純粋卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ患者には保存的手術が望ましい治療であることを示唆する。再発リスクは初回手術の種類よりも、補助化学療法または放射線療法を行わなかったことと関連している可能性がある。
